# Make it obvious what functions do

## Make it obvious what functions do {transition="slide-in fade-out"}

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: 1-10|1-1
my_fun <- function(x, y, z) {
  y2 <- ceiling(y * z * 100) / 100
  y3 <- y + y2
  data.frame(
    item = x,
    price = y,
    sales_tax = y2,
    total_price = y3
  )
}
```

## Make it obvious what functions do {transition="fade-in fade-out"}

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: 1-1
compile_order_df <- function(x, y, z) {
  y2 <- ceiling(y * z * 100) / 100
  y3 <- y + y2
  data.frame(
    item = x,
    price = y,
    sales_tax = y2,
    total_price = y3
  )
}
```

## Make it obvious what functions do {transition="fade-in fade-out"}

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: 1-1
compile_order_df <- function(items, prices, tax_rate) {
  y2 <- ceiling(y * z * 100) / 100
  y3 <- y + y2
  data.frame(
    item = x,
    price = y,
    sales_tax = y2,
    total_price = y3
  )
}
```

## Make it obvious what functions do {transition="fade-in fade-out"}

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: 1-3|
compile_order_df <- function(items, prices, tax_rate) {
  sales_tax <- ceiling(prices * tax_rate * 100) / 100
  total_price <- prices + sales_tax
  data.frame(
    item = items,
    price = prices,
    sales_tax = sales_tax,
    total_price = total_price
  )
}
```

## Make it obvious what functions do {transition="fade-in fade-out"}

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: 1-1
#| eval: true
compile_order_df <- function(items, prices, tax_rate = 0.0825) {
  sales_tax <- ceiling(prices * tax_rate * 100) / 100
  total_price <- prices + sales_tax
  data.frame(
    item = items,
    price = prices,
    sales_tax = sales_tax,
    total_price = total_price
  )
}
```

## Make it obvious what functions do {transition="fade-in slide-out"}

# Forgive "close enough" input

## Forgive "close enough" input {transition="slide-in fade-out"}

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: 1-4|3-3
#| eval: true
compile_order_df(
  c("paper towels", "toilet paper"),
  c(12.33, 20.77)
)
```

## Forgive "close enough" input {transition="fade-in fade-out"}

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: 3-3
#| eval: true
#| error: true
compile_order_df(
  c("paper towels", "toilet paper"),
  c("12.33", "20.77")
)
```

## Forgive "close enough" input {transition="fade-in fade-out"}

```{r}
compile_order_df <- function(items, prices, tax_rate = 0.0825) {
  sales_tax <- ceiling(prices * tax_rate * 100) / 100
  total_price <- prices + sales_tax
  data.frame(
    item = items,
    price = prices,
    sales_tax = sales_tax,
    total_price = total_price
  )
}
```

## Forgive "close enough" input: base? {transition="fade-in fade-out"}

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: 2-2
#| eval: true
compile_order_df <- function(items, prices, tax_rate = 0.0825) {
  prices <- as.numeric(prices)
  sales_tax <- ceiling(prices * tax_rate * 100) / 100
  total_price <- prices + sales_tax
  data.frame(
    item = items,
    price = prices,
    sales_tax = sales_tax,
    total_price = total_price
  )
}
```

## Forgive "close enough" input: base? {transition="fade-in fade-out"}

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: 3-3
#| eval: true
compile_order_df(
  c("paper towels", "toilet paper"),
  c("12.33", "20.77")
)
```

## Forgive "close enough" input: base? {transition="fade-in fade-out"}

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: 3-3
#| eval: true
#| warning: true
compile_order_df(
  c("paper towels", "toilet paper"),
  c("12.33", "b")
)
```

## Forgive "close enough" input: vctrs? {transition="fade-in fade-out"}

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: 2-2
#| eval: true
compile_order_df <- function(items, prices, tax_rate = 0.0825) {
  prices <- vctrs::vec_cast(prices, double())
  sales_tax <- ceiling(prices * tax_rate * 100) / 100
  total_price <- prices + sales_tax
  data.frame(
    item = items,
    price = prices,
    sales_tax = sales_tax,
    total_price = total_price
  )
}
```

## Forgive "close enough" input: vctrs? {transition="fade-in fade-out"}

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: 3-3
#| eval: true
#| error: true
compile_order_df(
  c("paper towels", "toilet paper"),
  c("12.33", "20.77")
)
```

## Forgive "close enough" input: stbl {transition="fade-in fade-out"}

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: 2-2
#| eval: true
compile_order_df <- function(items, prices, tax_rate = 0.0825) {
  prices <- stbl::to_dbl(prices)
  sales_tax <- ceiling(prices * tax_rate * 100) / 100
  total_price <- prices + sales_tax
  data.frame(
    item = items,
    price = prices,
    sales_tax = sales_tax,
    total_price = total_price
  )
}
```

## Forgive "close enough" input: stbl {transition="fade-in fade-out"}

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: 3-3
#| eval: true
#| error: true
compile_order_df(
  c("paper towels", "toilet paper"),
  c("12.33", "b")
)
```

::: notes
- Show `stbl::to_int()` vs `as.integer()` (NAs introduced) vs over-strict `vctrs::vec_cast("1", integer())`
- Use this to lead to error section.
:::

# Tell users how to fix mistakes

## Tell users how to fix mistakes {transition="slide-in fade-out"}

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: 3-3
#| eval: true
#| error: true
compile_order_df(
  c("paper towels", "toilet paper"),
  c("a", "b")
)
```

::: notes
- Show that the error is the same for "a", "b" and "1", "2" (i.e., the error is not helpful).
- Show error messages before stbl. `x + y` throws fun, hard to understand errors.
- Show stbl-style errors.
:::
